item.title: Walpole Island murder trial: Witnesses offer differing versions of events
item.description: The jury hearing a Walpole Island first-degree murder and kidnapping trial at the Sarnia courthouse was sent home early Wednesday.

item.title: Arson charge dropped in 2024 Chatham apartment fire; tenants shocked
item.description: Some residents were shocked to learn an arson charge has been dropped against the remaining person charged in an August 2024 fire

item.title: Smoke alarms help Chatham residents escape fire
item.description: Smoke alarms are being credited for helping occupants escape a house fire Tuesday in Chatham.

item.title: Chatham investment plan at Dajcor on hold as tariff uncertainty remains
item.description: Chatham manufacturer has $1.6M in funding to help expand its operation, but U.S.-imposed tariffs have put a hold on planned investments

item.title: Chatham man to stand trial for dangerous driving in deadly crash
item.description: A Chatham man will stand trial for dangerous driving causing death stemming from an early 2025 crash that killed a Tilbury teen.

item.description: Chatham-Kent councillors will receive an update Monday concerning Wheatley's ongoing revitalization efforts.

item.description: The Chatham Kent U13 C Crush struck gold at the Durham West Bolts and Hearts tournament last weekend.

item.title: Walpole Island murder trial witness recalls night of shooting, fire, but not very well
item.description: Another witness who was there the night Oyebode Oyenuga was killed testified Thursday as a Walpole Island murder trial continued in Sarnia.
